suppression.notes: False positive: the CPE matcher maps the Maven coordinate org.eclipse.jgit:org.eclipse.jgit onto unrelated "git" CVEs that affect the C implementation of git, not the pure Java JGit library. GitGrader never invokes the git binary; all Git operations go through JGit.

False positive: com.github.docker-java is a Java client for the Docker Engine API and is repeatedly matched against CVEs in Docker Engine or the Docker daemon itself. Engine hardening is an operational concern documented in docs/security.md, not a property of this library.

Not applicable, and not yet fixable. CVE-2026-66299 is an unbounded buffer in the WebSocket chat example, which lives in the examples web application. This is embedded Tomcat: tomcat-embed-core ships no web applications at all, so the vulnerable code is not on the classpath. Tomcat's own advisory says installations without the examples are not affected. It is fixed in 11.0.25, which is unreleased, so there is no version to move to; tomcat.version is already at 11.0.24, which is what clears the other five. Revisit when 11.0.25 ships.
